(b) A software or product used by a person to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.\"},{\"field\":\"status\",\"quoted_span\":\"PROPOSED ACTIONS: Amend San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8 by adding new Division 11, sections 98.1101, 98.1102, 98.1103, and 98.1104, to adopt the proposed Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance.\"},{\"field\":\"effective_date\",\"quoted_span\":\"This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.\"}]","key_value":"ban on use of algorithmic pricing software that uses nonpublic competitor data to set rental rates or occupancy levels","coverage_conditions":"Applies to residential rental property in the City of San Diego","exemptions":"Software publishing aggregated historical data more than 90 days old from public sources without recommending future rates; software establishing rates under local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines","effective_date":null,"conflict_note":"Document marked as proposed ordinance with staff report dated February 27, 2025.
